name: Emem Ufeh
title: Full Stack Developer
summary: Dynamic Full Stack Developer with expertise in Python, JavaScript, and Docker, specializing in creating scalable, user-friendly solutions that drive business impact. Passionate about leveraging AI/ML, NLP, and modern web technologies to solve real-world problems. Proven track record in building innovative projects, from AI-powered chatbots to real-time dashboards, with a focus on Agile methodologies, clean code practices, and cloud deployment. Eager to contribute to forward-thinking teams at innovative companies—open to beta opportunities in web development and AI integration.
about: Hi there! I'm Emem, a passionate Full Stack Developer and tech enthusiast based in Abuja, Nigeria. With a strong foundation in both front-end and back-end technologies, I thrive on building innovative, functional applications that address everyday challenges. My journey in tech has been fueled by a love for continuous learning, collaborating on open-source projects, and delivering high-impact solutions. Skilled in rapid prototyping and deployment, I'm seeking collaborative beta roles to push boundaries in AI-driven web development.

experience.description: Designed and deployed full-stack applications using React, Next.js, Flask, and Django, integrating AI/ML models for features like NLP-based resume scanners and real-time stock predictors. Optimized database performance with PostgreSQL and MongoDB, resulting in 30% faster query times. Collaborated with clients via Agile sprints to deliver user-centric solutions, including a Termux-based FM radio player with 50+ downloads on GitHub.

Contributed to web development projects using JavaScript, Python, and AWS, focusing on front-end UI/UX with React and back-end APIs with FastAPI. Implemented Docker containers for seamless deployment, reducing setup time by 40%. Participated in code reviews and open-source contributions, enhancing skills in version control and CI/CD pipelines.

Assisted in building scalable web apps with MERN stack, incorporating data visualization tools like Plotly. Gained hands-on experience with Git/GitHub workflows and basic ML integration using Scikit-learn, supporting team efforts in prototyping AI chatbots.

projects.name: Termux Radio Player
projects.description: A modern FM radio player for Android's Termux environment using streamurl.link API. Features real-time streaming, playlist management, and offline caching. Built with Shell scripting for lightweight performance; garnered 1 star and positive feedback on GitHub.

projects.name: DreamLayer AI Fork
projects.description: Forked and enhanced Recraft V2 text-to-image node with unit tests for client challenges. Integrated PyTorch for model fine-tuning, enabling faster image generation workflows.
projects.achievements: Improved inference speed by 20%; 1 star on GitHub

projects.name: AI-Powered Resume Scanner
projects.description: NLP-based tool using spaCy and Hugging Face to parse resumes and match job descriptions. Features PDF extraction, skill extraction, and ATS-friendly scoring; deployed on Vercel for demo access.
projects.achievements: Processed 100+ sample resumes; 85% accuracy in skill matching

projects.name: Real-Time Stock Predictor Dashboard
projects.description: Interactive web app with React front-end and Django back-end for ML-driven stock predictions using historical data. Includes visualizations via Plotly and real-time updates via WebSockets.
projects.achievements: Integrated live API feeds; Demoed to 20+ peers with positive reviews

projects.description: Customized GitHub profile README with dynamic badges, tech stack showcase, and project highlights using JavaScript for interactivity.
projects.achievements: 2 stars; Enhanced personal branding for recruiter visibility
